verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents CI/CD-triggerable automations, including detecting failed workflows, inspecting logs, and opening a PR with a proposed fix (openhands-docs-9), plus webhook/schedule-triggered automations integrating with GitHub (openhands-gh-4) and an Agent Server API for scripting/automation (openhands-docs-13, openhands-docs-32). This directly supports triggering an agent to fix a broken build or failing test. missing for 10: no explicit dedicated CI test-failure example (e.g., failing unit test remediation) walkthrough, no first-party GitHub Actions YAML sample, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow succeeding.
